title: MgB2 thin film deposition by HPCVD at 720 °C
body:
We deposited MgB2 thin films on (0001) Al2O3 substrates using hybrid physical–chemical vapor deposition.
[Step] Substrate prep
  [Input] Al2O3 wafer, [Tool] ultrasonic acetone bath (10 min)
[Step] Deposition
  [Parameter] T = 720 °C, P(B2H6) = 350 mTorr, [Output] 250 nm film
[Step] Characterisation
  [Tool] XRD (Cu Kα), four-probe Tc measurement, [Output] Tc = 38.5 K, single (0001) orientation
Last week's 680 °C run gave a much broader transition. Raising the substrate temperature likely improved Mg incorporation and reduced impurity phases.
